text:
jenna: Quick-ish question — candidate for SWE2 on Wed needs an accommodation (keyboard/mouse). Can we confirm room + AV and whether we should swap to a remote coding task?
akshay: thanks for flagging. who is the candidate? can you paste the accommodation note?
jenna: name's Taylor. Accommodation says: needs ergonomic keyboard and extra 10 min per exercise. Prefers in-person but ok remote if we can't guarantee gear.
samir_patel: @people-ops can we reserve the small interview room on floor 4 and request an external keyboard from facilities? I can bring my spare if needed.
people-ops: putting in a facilities request now, cc: @matthew for AV. ETA 2h. Also tagging accessibility team.
matthew: I can bring a mechanical keyboard and a usb hub. If we swap to remote, we should change the task to a design-first prompt (no heavy local setup).
nina: small note on scoring — since they get +10m, do we adjust rubric timing or eval windows? we usually don't alter score expectations.
jenna: good point. suggest we let panel know they get extended time but keep the rubric same. call out in debrief "timing accommodation provided" so reviewers are aware.
akshay: +1 to calling it out. also, can we assign a scribe who notes pacing and whether the extra time affected completion? that helps normalization later.
samir_patel: i'll scribe if nobody else. can we also standardize the extra-time marker in the feedback form? maybe a checkbox: "accommodation applied" so recruiting can filter.
people-ops: added a checkbox to the form (live now). has anyone changed the calendar invites to include "accommodation: extra 10m" so panel knows ahead?
jenna: i've updated all invites and pinned a short note in the candidate doc. snippet I pasted in invites: ```Accommodation: Candidate approved for extra 10 minutes per coding exercise. Please note in feedback.```
matthew: LGTM. one more ask — if we decide to run remote coding, please replace the pair-programming exercise with the take-home style prompt we keep in docs: /interview-assets/remote-friendly-coding.md
nina: on scoring, we'll not renormalize scores for a single candidate. if we see a pattern we'll discuss. for this case, debrief note + scribe should be sufficient.
jenna: thanks y'all. samir, matthew — can you confirm you have the gear and will be onsite by 1:30p?
samir_patel: confirmed. 1:15p on site. bringing keyboard.
matthew: confirmed. bringing hub + keyboard.
people-ops: facilities confirmed keyboard delivery to room 4B at 1:20p. accessibility team notified. closing the loop. :white_check_mark:
